cs.t: I am using a keyboardio model 100 with the default layout. I have had it since it came out (I think that has been about 2 years now). It has had the best ergo layout I have tried for programming. I think a big part of it is the palm (fn) button is so nice for getting to alternate characters without feeling like I have to strain for a modifier key.  https://shop.keyboard.io/products/model-100
